verdict.rationale: Proton Pass generates TOTP codes, so a smartwatch surface for reading them is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions a smartwatch app, Wear OS or Apple Watch support, or any wrist-based code access. The documented surfaces are mobile apps, browser extensions, desktop and CLI.

support.subject: As an everyday user, I can read my codes from my smartwatch without pulling out my phone
